policy: Coverage fail_under is a one-way ratchet on the Linux CI monolith (pytest --cov=buildml). Raise when that gate improves; never lower to silence a regression. Floors must be set from that gate or scripts/run_full_coverage.py in monolith mode, never from a tiny subset or from a Windows isolated combine that skips crashed modules.

schedule.notes: Interim floor after partial-suite ~26%; replaced once full-suite measured ~70.7%
Skipped; full-suite already cleared 60 with headroom
Superseded once fail_under raised to 70; full-suite Windows isolated combine measured 70.71%
Windows isolated combine measured 70.71% with 31 crashed modules. That is not the Linux CI monolith gate. Superseded in 2.6.0 once the gate actually ran pytest --cov=buildml.
Linux CI monolith (pytest --cov=buildml) measured 66.67% (40630/60938) on the 2.6.0 cut. That job is the coverage gate.

how_to_raise: Run: python scripts/run_full_coverage.py --update-ratchet (monolith on Linux; isolated on Windows is informational only)
Confirm TOTAL exceeds the next target with >=1.0pp headroom on the gate platform (Linux CI)
Bump fail_under in pyproject.toml and this file's current field
Update CONTRIBUTING.md ratchet note, docs/stability.md, and CHANGELOG
